body_lead: AI errors, inflated prices: Tamil Nadu govt orders probe into Periyar library books The controversy comes weeks after the opening of Periyar Arivulagam, or Periyar Knowledge World, a library and science centre named after social reformer Periyar EV Ramasamy. A Tamil classic described as a “poet and philosopher”. A book crediting MK Stalin with government schemes from the years when his father was chief minister.
